title: Dictate: the stop chime could silently drop or double

set.outcome:
**Fixed: the stop chime could drop or double.** `beep()` (ext/Chat/Mic.js) scheduled its notes before the AudioContext had finished waking up, so a chime with no fresh click behind it — the page-hidden stop, or the very first beep — could land silent or mistimed. A whisper error mid-stop also made it fire twice, as one garbled noise.

- [x] stop chime plays once, only once the context is really running — reasoning: [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/doc/decisions/)
- [x] no more doubled chime when whisper errors mid-stop — same doc
- [x] readme's Watch out points here: [readme.md](/framework/ux/Dictate/)
- [ ] confirmed with `node --check` or a live mic — sandbox blocked `node`; needs a follow-up check

Only file touched: `ext/Chat/Mic.js`.
